lines.text: A Maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite.
I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever;
with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.
For I have said, “Loving devotion is built up forever;
in the heavens You establish Your faithfulness.”
You said, “I have made a covenant with My chosen one,
I have sworn to David My servant:
and build up your throne for all generations.’”
The heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD—
in the assembly of the holy ones.
For who in the skies can compare with the LORD?
Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?
In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared,
and awesome above all who surround Him.

pictures.scene: Frans Hals, Two Singing Boys — the two boys leaning into one sheet of music with their mouths open on the same note, a Maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite, I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever
pictures.name: pd_hals_zingen

pictures.scene: Albert Anker, Grossmutter mit Bibel — the old woman with the big Bible open on her knees reading it out to the child beside her, with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations, for I have said, loving devotion is built up forever
pictures.name: pd_anker_geslachten

pictures.scene: Fyodor Vasilyev, Wet Meadow — the enormous clearing sky standing over the wet grass after the rain has gone over, in the heavens You establish Your faithfulness, You said, I have made a covenant with My chosen one
pictures.name: pd_vasilyev_hemel

pictures.scene: Jacques-Louis David, The Oath of the Horatii — the brothers stretching out their hands to the swords and swearing with their whole bodies, I have sworn to David My servant, I will establish your offspring forever
pictures.name: pd_david_gezworen

pictures.scene: Canaletto, The Stonemason's Yard — the masons at work on the blocks in the open yard with the great church going up behind them, and build up your throne for all generations
pictures.name: pd_canaletto_bouwen

pictures.scene: Martin Johnson Heade, Thunder Storm on Narragansett Bay — the black storm sky standing over the bay with the last light still lying on the water, the heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD, Your faithfulness as well
pictures.name: pd_heade_wonderen

pictures.scene: Claudio Coello, La Sagrada Forma — the whole company of priests and kneeling men gathered round the raised host in the sacristy, in the assembly of the holy ones, for who in the skies can compare with the LORD
pictures.name: pd_coello_vergadering

pictures.scene: Francisco de Zurbarán, La Virgen de las Cuevas — the white-robed monks kneeling under the Virgin's spread mantle while she holds it open over them, who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD, in the council of the holy ones God is greatly feared
pictures.name: pd_zurbaran_raad

pictures.scene: Vasily Surikov, Suvorov Crossing the Alps — the whole army going down the snow face of the mountain past the old general on the ridge, and awesome above all who surround Him, O LORD God of Hosts, who is like You
pictures.name: pd_surikov_ontzag
